name: byagent
description: Shareable links for the HTML and Markdown your AI agents publish, with line comments.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, every published page and its versions, and this install's admin token and signing key (.admin-token, .key-signing-secret). Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: byagent pages, API and dashboard, published on host as 6699

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6699, or use your https domain. Every link byagent hands out (pages, comments, the dashboard) starts with this address.
